name: ark
description: Before you kill an instance: copy its logs, config and data somewhere safe (S3, rclone, or a mounted disk), with a manifest and checksums.

dest.about: where copies go: an s3://bucket/prefix, an rclone 'remote:path', or a local/mounted folder

sources.about: space-separated paths to copy (add your app's data, uploads, state)

aws_access_key_id.about: for an s3:// dest, if this box has no instance role or ~/.aws credentials (kept in secrets.env)
